items.label: One-Touch Height Adjustment
items.value: Easily adjust the FEZIBO electric standing desk from 28.3" to 46.5". With 3 customizable memory presets, switch seamlessly between sitting and standing. Ideal for home offices, gaming setups, study areas, and productive workspaces

items.label: Outstanding Stability
items.value: Built with a reinforced steel frame, this 47.2" x 23.6" standing desk supports up to 176 lbs, providing a sturdy and wobble-free workspace at any height

items.label: Powerful Motor
items.value: Uprated lifting performance with reliable long-term operation, tested for up to 50,000 lift cycles, with lower noise levels under 45dB during running

items.label: Multiple Sizes & Colors
items.value: Crafted from FSC-certified wood for a sustainable choice, the splice desktop comes in a range of sizes to fit small spaces or larger setups. Multiple color options make it easy to match your home office, bedroom, or workspace style

items.label: Effortless Assembly
items.value: Most components come pre-assembled for quick, hassle-free setup. With a detailed manual and video guide, you can setup in just about 30 minutes and start working comfortably

items.label: Item Dimensions D X W X H
Assembly Instructions Description
items.value: Attach legs with screws. Tighten using the provided tool. Connect desktop to frame using bolts. Insert desktop in two pieces onto the frame. Ensure desktop is properly aligned and secured.
